text:
emily (Partnerships): Heads-up — prepping joint onboarding for Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector bundle. Need a quick risk assessment, GTM playbook, and legal/compliance checklist by EOD Wed. Who can own which pieces?

miguel (Eng Integrations): I can own the tech onboarding + connector certification tests. Will put up test matrix tomorrow.

raj (GTM): I'll own marketplace listing copy + launch timeline. Can we target a coordinated listing next month? Need partner approval for logos.

sophia (Security): Please add a data-flow diagram and list of auth modes (OAuth, API key, SSO). I need to sign off on encryption at rest/in transit and token handling.

emily (Partnerships): Uploaded baseline diagrams here: https://redwood.internal/drive/conn-bundle-diagrams (private). Also added a stub auth matrix in the doc.

miguel (Eng Integrations): Test plan draft coming. Quick config snippet for Qdrant connector (for cert harness):
```
connector:
  type: qdrant
  url: https://qdrant.example
  auth: oauth2
  batch_size: 512
```
Share any edge-case queries you want covered.

raj (GTM): For messaging — do we position this as "unified vector ingestion" or "data platform connector bundle"? Need short tagline for marketplace hero.

emily (Partnerships): Leaning toward "platform-first vector connectors" — emphasizes ease of serving with Redwood. But open to phrasing.

nina (Legal): Quick heads-up: partners want a review of data processing terms if connectors surface customer data to partner-managed services. Send any example telemetry or logs we collect.

sophia (Security): Also flag: Snowflake integration uses external function calls in some flows — require explicit allowlist and query sanitization. Add that to the tech checklist.

miguel (Eng Integrations): Noted. I'll add an allowlist section and test for SQL injection + credential rotation.

raj (GTM): Timeline check: if tech certs finish in two weeks and legal signs off, we can plan a co-announce 3 weeks out. Do partners have blackout windows?

emily (Partnerships): Partners said mid-June is fine but they'd prefer no other product announcements that week. I'll confirm.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Connector Bundle Coordination" — Wed 14:00 PT (invite sent to participants). :calendar:

nina (Legal): Please drop any sample contract addendum here before the meeting so I can review.

emily (Partnerships): Will do. Also adding a short risk matrix in the doc: operational (rate limits / burst), security (data flow / encryption), legal (DPA/cross-border).

raj (GTM): I'll draft marketplace listing + hero copy and post a variant for review by EOD Tue. @miguel @sophia please thumbs-up or leave edits. :thumbsup:

miguel (Eng Integrations): :+1:

sophia (Security): :+1:

emily (Partnerships): Thanks all — meeting notes + action items after Wed. If anyone needs to own an extra item, shout here.
